steps.label: kubectl describe pod

steps.label: kubectl logs --previous
steps.sub: what the container itself said before it died

eyebrow: Four states that mean four different things
code:
Pending            -> not yet scheduled (resources, taints, selectors)
ImagePullBackOff   -> can't pull the image (name, tag, registry auth)
CrashLoopBackOff   -> app exits on startup, Kubernetes keeps retrying
OOMKilled          -> container exceeded its memory limit
caption: kubectl describe pod's Events section and kubectl logs --previous resolve almost all four.

steps.label: kubectl cordon node-03

steps.label: kubectl drain node-03 --ignore-daemonsets
